quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #9
										  					
  

40 Questions • Passing Score 35

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: Divided highway ends.
questions.explanation: This sign warns drivers that the divided highway is ending ahead.

questions.question: What type of road feature does this sign show?
questions.correctAnswerText: Intersection.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that a T intersection is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: Slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns drivers that the road becomes slippery when wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: Slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black symbols or words. This sign tells drivers to be careful because the road may become wet and slippery.

questions.question: What does a green arrow on a lane control signal mean?

options.text: No traffic is allowed in this lane.
You must merge into this lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: You may use this lane.
questions.explanation: A steady green arrow pointing down means you can use that lane.

questions.question: What does a yellow and black diamond-shaped sign do?

options.text: Warns you about conditions on or near the road.
Helps direct you to cities and towns ahead.
Tells you about traffic laws and regulations.
Tells you about road construction ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Warns you about conditions on or near the road.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black symbols or words on a yellow background. They alert you to conditions ahead on or near the road.

questions.question: When may you carefully drive through an intersection with a yellow light?

options.text: There is an emergency vehicle crossing your lane.
You are already in the intersection when the light turns yellow.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are already in the intersection when the light turns yellow.
questions.explanation: If you are already in the intersection when the light turns yellow, you may continue through carefully.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for traffic on your right.
Don't park on the right side of the street.

questions.correctAnswerText: No right turn.
questions.explanation: A red circle with a line through a symbol means that action is not allowed. This sign means no right turn.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The left lane is reserved for vehicles with a specific number of occupants.
Specific turning movements are allowed from specific lanes.
Drivers in both lanes are responsible for merging smoothly.

questions.correctAnswerText: The left lane is reserved for vehicles with a specific number of occupants.
questions.explanation: This sign marks a high occupancy vehicle (HOV) lane. It is reserved for buses and vehicles with a driver plus one or more passengers, as shown on the sign.

questions.question: What does this road sign show?

options.text: The maximum safe speed for a residential area.
The maximum safe speed for an expressway exit.
The maximum safe speed for an expressway entrance.
The maximum safe speed for a work zone.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum safe speed for an expressway exit.
questions.explanation: This sign shows the maximum safe speed for exiting a highway. In this example, the safe exit speed is 30 mph.

questions.question: A bicyclist who doesn't obey traffic laws:

options.text: Is correct because bicyclists don't have to follow traffic laws.
Will always get a warning from police.
Will have their bicycle taken away.

questions.correctAnswerText: Can be ticketed.
questions.explanation: Bicyclists have the same rights and responsibilities as car drivers. Both can be ticketed for breaking traffic laws.

questions.question: You should signal to turn ____ before you turn.
questions.correctAnswerText: 100 feet
questions.explanation: Signal at least 100 feet before you turn or change lanes. Keep signaling until you finish the turn or lane change.

questions.question: If you see this sign, you:

options.text: May pass a slow vehicle if you do it quickly.
May pass if you know the road ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Must not pass another vehicle.
questions.explanation: Regulatory signs have black markings on a white background. You must follow all regulatory signs. This sign means you cannot pass other vehicles.

questions.question: At an intersection with a yield sign, you should:

options.text: Yield only to traffic on the right.
Yield only to traffic on the left.
Slow down and let other traffic go first.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and let other traffic go first.
questions.explanation: A yield sign means slow down and let other traffic in the intersection or on the road you are entering go first.

questions.question: In normal weather and traffic, stay at least ____ behind the car ahead of you.
questions.correctAnswerText: Three seconds
questions.explanation: More distance gives you more time to react. Keep three seconds of space in normal weather and traffic. Increase this distance in bad weather or heavy traffic.

questions.question: Some highways use ____ to show drivers which lanes to use for turning.

options.text: White lines on the side of the road
White arrows in the middle of lanes

questions.correctAnswerText: White arrows in the middle of lanes
questions.explanation: White arrows in lanes show which lanes to use for going straight or turning.

questions.question: You want to back out of your driveway. Children are playing nearby. Before you move, you should:

options.text: Rev your engine to warn the children.
Honk your horn so children can hear you.
Walk to the back of the car to check if the path is clear.
Tell the children to stay away.

questions.correctAnswerText: Walk to the back of the car to check if the path is clear.
questions.explanation: Look through your back window before backing up. Don't just use mirrors, especially when children are nearby. Always get out and check behind your vehicle before backing.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: The road is slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road is slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road becomes very slippery when it gets wet.

questions.question: When is it illegal to drive slower than the speed limit?

options.text: When driving slowly blocks the normal flow of traffic
When in heavy traffic in a construction zone

questions.correctAnswerText: When driving slowly blocks the normal flow of traffic
questions.explanation: It is illegal to drive so slowly that you block normal traffic. You can get a ticket for driving too slowly.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.correctAnswerText: Two-way traffic ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that traffic is moving in both directions ahead.

questions.question: You see a "Merging traffic" sign on the freeway. What should you do?

options.text: Always stay at your current speed.
Speed up to avoid slowing down traffic.
Move to another lane, if safe, to let traffic merge in.

questions.correctAnswerText: Move to another lane, if safe, to let traffic merge in.
questions.explanation: Make room for vehicles entering the road. If the lane next to you is empty, move over to let them in.

questions.question: Why should you be careful when passing a bicycle?

options.text: Your car is faster than the bicycle.
The bicycle always has the right-of-way.
Oncoming traffic may not see you move out to pass.
The cyclist may swerve into traffic to avoid something on the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: The cyclist may swerve into traffic to avoid something on the road.
questions.explanation: Be very careful when passing a bicycle. The cyclist may suddenly swerve to avoid objects on the road, which could put them in front of traffic.

questions.question: When driving near a motorcycle, what must you do?

options.text: Allow the motorcycle to use a full lane.
Drive on the shoulder next to the motorcycle.
Allow the motorcycle to use only half of a lane.
Pass by sharing the same lane as the motorcycle.

questions.correctAnswerText: Allow the motorcycle to use a full lane.
questions.explanation: A motorcycle is a full-size vehicle with the same rights as any other vehicle. Give motorcyclists a complete lane width. Even if there seems to be room to share a lane, motorcycles need space to move safely.

questions.question: Two vehicles arrive at an intersection at the same time with no signs or signals. Which car has the right-of-way?

options.text: The car coming from the right.
The car coming from the left.
The car whose driver honks first.

questions.correctAnswerText: The car coming from the right.
questions.explanation: At an intersection with no traffic control, always yield to a vehicle coming from your right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: No U-turn.
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed.

questions.question: When can you pass another vehicle?

options.text: On a curve or hill because few other vehicles are likely there.
By driving on the highway shoulder.
If your lane has a solid yellow line and the passing lane is clear.

questions.correctAnswerText: None of the above.
questions.explanation: Do not pass on a hill or curve because you cannot see oncoming traffic. Never pass by driving on the shoulder. Do not pass across a solid yellow line.

questions.question: Before passing another vehicle, when should you signal?

options.text: Early enough so others know what you plan to do.

questions.correctAnswerText: Early enough so others know what you plan to do.
questions.explanation: Signal early before passing so other drivers have time to see what you are doing.

questions.question: In bad weather, how many seconds should your following distance be?
questions.correctAnswerText: Four or five seconds.
questions.explanation: The more space between your car and others, the more time you have to react. In bad weather, keep four or five seconds of distance.

questions.question: Which statement about winter driving is false?

options.text: Winter is the hardest driving season.
Check your antifreeze and windshield washer fluid in winter.
Using cruise control in winter weather is safe.
Snow tires are best to use in winter.

questions.correctAnswerText: Using cruise control in winter weather is safe.
questions.explanation: Do not use cruise control in snow, rain, fog, or other bad weather. Winter driving is challenging and needs extra care. Check your antifreeze and washer fluid often. Snow tires help your car grip slippery roads.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: Crossroad ahead.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to upcoming road conditions. This sign warns that an intersection is coming.

questions.question: A leaky exhaust system is dangerous because it can cause:
questions.correctAnswerText: Carbon monoxide poisoning.
questions.explanation: The exhaust system removes exhaust gas from your vehicle and keeps fumes out of the passenger area. Fix any leaks in your exhaust system right away to prevent carbon monoxide poisoning.

questions.question: A flashing yellow light at an intersection means you should:

options.text: Slow down and proceed with care.
Stop and proceed when a green light appears.
Stop and proceed when the way is clear.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and proceed with care.
questions.explanation: A flashing yellow light means "caution." Slow down, look both ways, and proceed with care.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.correctAnswerText: No right turn.
questions.explanation: This sign means right turns are not allowed. Do not turn right at an intersection with this sign.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.correctAnswerText: Lane ends.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow and black. They alert drivers to road hazards ahead. This sign warns that a lane is ending and traffic must merge. Be ready to allow other vehicles to merge safely.

questions.question: When driving near heavy trucks, you must allow for:

options.text: The increased stopping distance required by large vehicles.
The decreased stopping distance required by large vehicles.
The decreased noise of larger vehicles.
The increased speed of larger vehicles.

questions.correctAnswerText: The increased stopping distance required by large vehicles.
questions.explanation: Large vehicles need more distance to stop. Stay in areas where the truck driver can see you. Keep your view of traffic clear by not driving beside or behind large trucks.

questions.question: When driving in traffic, it is safest to:

options.text: Change your speed to stay alert.
Drive with the flow of traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drive with the flow of traffic.
questions.explanation: Crashes happen when drivers go much faster or slower than other vehicles. Drive at the same speed as surrounding traffic while staying within the speed limit.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: A community service group is picking up trash along the highway ahead.
Workers are on or very close to the road in the work zone ahead.
There is a pedestrian crosswalk ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Workers are on or very close to the road in the work zone ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that workers are on or near the road ahead. Drive carefully through work zones.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: When pavement is wet, reduce your speed.
The road ahead winds with turns or curves.

questions.correctAnswerText: When pavement is wet, reduce your speed.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road is slippery when wet. In wet conditions, slow down, avoid sudden braking or turning, and increase your following distance.

questions.question: When approaching a flashing yellow arrow, drivers:

options.text: Should merge into the lane in the direction of the arrow.
Should come to a complete stop.
May turn left after yielding to oncoming traffic and pedestrians.
Have the right-of-way and may expect oncoming traffic to stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: May turn left after yielding to oncoming traffic and pedestrians.
questions.explanation: A flashing yellow arrow allows left turns in the direction of the arrow. However, oncoming traffic has a green light. You must yield to them and to pedestrians before turning.

questions.question: For drivers 21 or older, it is illegal to drive with a blood alcohol concentration (BAC) of:
questions.correctAnswerText: 0.08 percent.
questions.explanation: For drivers 21 and older, a BAC of 0.08 percent or higher is illegal. Driving under the influence of alcohol is illegal and dangerous.
